scope: Code-level continuity checks and live browser inspection on a Mac at desktop and mobile viewport sizes; not measured on a physical phone.
changes: Fractional Remotion scroll frames replace whole-frame rounding in both passages.
Runner exit uses composited translation instead of changing left.
Analog cell lettering is cached between letter changes.
GPU point drawing replaces the full-field Canvas blur and bitmap copies; full-density Canvas fallback remains available.

evidence.previousQuantization: On a 390×844 viewport, whole-frame scene travel jumped approximately 5.6–9.4 CSS pixels; fractional positions now reach the Player unchanged.
evidence.fallbackObserved: Canvas fallback displayed the same full field when accelerated setup initially failed; shader compatibility was corrected and GPU initialization verified.
evidence.analogLetterRasterization: 18 letter-layer rebuilds instead of 161 across integer frames 0–160; ordinary frames use cached layers.
evidence.drawingCaveat: data-draw-ms measures command submission, not GPU completion; no device FPS improvement is claimed.
